reason_for_revision.v6_feedback_bypass: The resident prompt exposed world.route_snapshot() in every condition, so full_minus_feedback could observe a closure without the feedback path.
reason_for_revision.v6_opportunity_failure: Free plan generation allowed some valid backend runs to contain no primary-route plan, making feedback and replanning outcomes partly opportunity-limited.
reason_for_revision.treatment_of_v6: Preserve every raw result and use v6 only as a backend and design diagnostic; do not reinterpret it as formal mechanism evidence.

frozen_contract.true_world_state: Authoritative physical arbitration state; the route closes in every condition.
frozen_contract.resident_route_state: A copied perceived snapshot, never a live reference to true world state.
frozen_contract.feedback_enabled: Refresh perceived routes after world changes and expose the refreshed perception at the next decision.
frozen_contract.feedback_disabled: Retain the pre-closure perceived route snapshot; rejected physical actions do not directly reveal the hidden closure.
frozen_contract.controlled_initial_plan: Every decision resident privately begins with tiger_primary, the household vehicle, and departure step 5. This is an experimental initial condition, not generated behavior or a shared commitment.
frozen_contract.planning_enabled: A resident decision may replace the private plan after the controlled closure.
frozen_contract.planning_disabled: The controlled initial plan remains, but model decisions cannot replace the private plan.
frozen_contract.interaction: Shared household coordination still requires sent -> delivered -> processed -> accepted/rejected messages.
frozen_contract.estimand: Paired full minus full-minus-module conditional removal effect in this controlled system state; not a universal standalone module effect.

execution_contract.paired_exclusion_rule: Exclude a module-seed pair if either cell is not VALID; preserve all attempts and never overwrite a run ID.

pre_execution_validation.mock_use_boundary: The deterministic backend was used only for structural invariants and CI, never as behavioral effect evidence.
asserted_invariants: The true primary route closes in full and full_minus_feedback.
Only feedback-enabled residents refresh the perceived route state.
Every condition receives the same controlled private initial plan.
The v7 feedback metric is temporally ordered around the closure.

completion_record.scheduling_amendment: After one valid full/seed101 cell, the remaining non-overlapping cells were distributed across two worker processes solely to reduce wall time. No seed, condition, prompt, metric, cohort, model, or stopping rule changed.

post_pilot_v8_additive_amendment.reason: The completed v7 full runs exposed that execution rejection reasons were stored but not returned to the next resident prompt. A prompt-version-gated v8 branch adds current-plan failure, recent execution feedback, household vehicle state, and explicit accepted-commitment execution guidance. The v7 prompt branch and all selected raw artifacts are unchanged.

claim_boundary: This declared DeepSeek run remains a PILOT for structural mechanism isolation, backend reliability, effect direction and paired-variance diagnosis. It is not Carr empirical validation, a historical closure reconstruction, a population estimate, or formal confirmatory evidence.
